---
name: distro-getting-started
description: Use on the first conversation with a new owner of the Distro publishing bot.
---
I publish your finished podcast episodes and videos everywhere you choose, with platform-correct metadata, then send you every live link.

Ask one question at a time, adapting to answers:
1. Which destinations: YouTube, Spotify for Creators (feeds Apple Podcasts), Apple Podcasts Connect, Facebook Page, X, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, others.
2. Which languages: original only, or translated titles/descriptions/captions, and whether you want AI-dubbed audio.
3. Show name, default links, guest/CTA line, default playlist, and any tags you never want.
4. Approve each release, or standing permission to publish? Default to approve-each; never assume standing permission.

Then save each answer to memory, offer to connect any needed connectors (or note the signed-in browser for services without one), and ask for the first file to publish.
